notes:
SCOPE: this is the Season 9 seasonal battle-pass tab (four chapters x seven tiers, a Seasonal Pass item, Seasonal Points currency, cosmetic rewards from the Vanity store). In the rexxar-reference tree it is ORPHANED: UIParent.lua:429 defines SeasonCollection_LoadUI but nothing calls it, Ascension_Collections registers no Season tab, and no file references SeasonCollectionFrame. It is clearly out of scope for a first release (a seasonal-realm feature; C_Realm.IsSeasonal gates the Unlock button); a shallow shim is enough, but every native above is still required for the frame to load and show without Lua errors.

LOAD ORDER / TOC: the .toc declares no Dependencies. parent="Collections" (SeasonCollectionUI.xml:5) and HideUIPanel(Collections) need Ascension_Collections loaded first; if it is not, the frame parents to nil (top-level, unscaled) and the close button nil-errors. PATCHES.md should add `## Dependencies: !AscensionShim, Ascension_Collections`.

LATENT BUGS in the shipped code (do not 'fix' in the verbatim copy, but do not chase them as shim faults): (1) SeasonRewardMixin:DisplayAnimatedSpell (:162) calls self:UpdateBorder(), which no mixin in its chain defines -> Lua error for ANIMATED_SPELL_VISUAL rewards. (2) DisplayCreature (:106) reads self.appearanceID, which ShowReward never assigns (it keeps a local), so GetCreatureDisplayItems is called with nil and creature rewards render without their gear. (3) SeasonTaskTemplate/SeasonTaskMixin are dead: nothing instantiates the template and the parent:GetCurrentTasks() it expects exists nowhere.

EVENTS: the frame never calls RegisterEvent itself. HookEvent/HookBucketEvent go through C_Hook (pure Lua, SharedXML/C_Hook.lua) whose HookHandler frame is RegisterAllEvents()'d; because the addon is insecure the registration takes the SetAttribute/OnAttributeChanged round-trip (stock-safe). ACHIEVEMENT_EARNED and CRITERIA_UPDATE therefore arrive natively on stock. The shim's EventBus must ALSO deliver synthesized custom events (ITEM_CACHE_REQUEST_SUCCESS, CREATURE_CACHE_REQUEST_SUCCESS, any EVENT verb from the wire) to C_Hook:SendEvent, not only to frames that called RegisterEvent, or every C_Hook consumer in the pack goes deaf.

ITEM CACHE PATH: Item:CancelableContinueOnLoad -> ItemQueryListener (FrameXML/Objects/AsyncCallbackHandler.lua) -> C_AssetQueryService.TryCacheItem(itemID) and then native ITEM_CACHE_REQUEST_SUCCESS(itemID). Stock 3.3.5 has no item-info-received event, so the shim's TryCacheItem should force a query (e.g. a hidden GameTooltip:SetHyperlink("item:<id>")) and poll GetItemInfo on a ticker, firing ITEM_CACHE_REQUEST_SUCCESS with the itemID when it resolves; the callback signature is fn(itemID). When the item is already cached the callback runs synchronously and CancelableContinueOnLoad returns nil (the addon guards self.cancelToken with `if`). Creature caching (CREATURE_CACHE_REQUEST_SUCCESS after TryCacheCreature) has no clean stock probe - Creature:CreateFromID(id):IsCached() must be answered somehow (e.g. a hidden Model:SetCreature + GetModel check) or CREATURE rewards will hang uncached.

SERVER / WIRE: three things must be served that DESIGN section 5 does not cover yet: (a) game-event state for ids 455-483 behind GetGameEventInfo (active, startTime, endTime, eventState); (b) IsSeasonalCollectionUnlocked and GetSeasonalCollectionInfo (names/icons/descriptions for the Draft and Points boxes); (c) the seasonal appearance catalogue (GetAvailableSeasons/GetAvailableChapters/GetSeasonalItems + GetAppearanceDisplayInfo/GetCreatureDisplayItems/C_ItemSet.GetAppearances). Achievements 10324-10680 with criteria 10007-10113 must exist in the server's achievement store (see the achievement-id-range memory: the imported Ascension Achievement.dbc ids need the widened int unsigned columns) and items 97397/97398 in item_template, otherwise GetItemCount reads 0 and the Unlock box title is never filled.

STOCK GAPS TO SHIM (beyond the native list): GetAchievementCriteriaInfo(criteriaID) one-arg form (wrap: resolve criteria id -> (achievementID, index) using the achievement half of the pair and the stock 10th return); PlaySound(number) mapping; Model:SetSpellVisual/SetSpell stubs; SetModelApplyComponents stub; GetItemInventoryType returning an index; OpenAscensionURL -> copy-URL popup; GetItemName/GetItemQuality answering before the cache fills.
